title: HtmlTable
responsibility: Renders the native table element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlTable.attributes
inputs.description: Native table attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlTable.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native table element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlTable
outputs.description: The actual native table element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
